title: 7 January 1965: Live: Another Beatles Christmas Show
content:
This was the 12th night of Another Beatles Christmas Show, which ran from 24 December 1964 to 16 January 1965 at London’s Hammersmith Odeon.

There were two shows on this night, with guest performers including Freddie And The Dreamers, Sounds Incorporated, Elkie Brooks, The Yardbirds, Michael Haslam, The Mike Cotton Sound and Ray Fell. The compère was Jimmy Savile.

The Beatles appeared in two sketches, one with Freddie Garrity of Freddie And The Dreamers, and another with Jimmy Savile. They closed the shows with an 11-song set: ‘Twist And Shout’, ‘I’m A Loser’, ‘Baby’s In Black’, ‘Everybody’s Trying To Be My Baby’, ‘Can’t Buy Me Love’, ‘Honey Don’t’, ‘I Feel Fine’, ‘She’s A Woman’, ‘A Hard Day’s Night’, ‘Rock And Roll Music’ and ‘Long Tall Sally’.

Page last updated: 13 October 2021

Also on this day...

  • 1976: Recording: She’s My Baby by Wings
  • 1972: Radio: John Lennon and Yoko ono for DPRO Vrijdag and The Joe Blow Show
  • 1972: Mixing: Attica State, The Luck Of The Irish, Sisters O Sisters, John Sinclair, Imagine by John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1969: Get Back/Let It Be sessions: day four
  • 1968: George Harrison flies to India
  • 1964: Live: The Beatles’ Christmas Show
  • 1964: Radio: Saturday Club
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Casbah Coffee Club, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Lathom Hall, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Aintree Institute, Liverpool
